svg.title: One decision, two readers: the package manager question on the interview page, and the same decision as a ledger entry, joined by the question ID r1-q19
svg.desc: Top, the page for you: question r1-q19, Package manager, with options pnpm, Bun, npm and Yarn Modern, a recommendation of pnpm then Bun when Bun is also the runtime, and your answer ranking pnpm first and Bun second, avoiding Yarn Classic. Bottom, the record for your agents: ledger entry P-18 in ledger.md with the same choices, why, source r1-q19(a,b), the options it chose over, and since r1.
